Caleb was eight. Every day after school it was the same answer: "Fine." 🙂 But on Sunday nights, his stomach hurt just thinking about Monday.

"Fine" can be a wall. One word that hides a lot of worry.

So his mom stopped asking "How was school?" and started asking small, specific questions, not all at once:
❓ Who did you sit with at lunch?
❓ Which grown-up at school would you go to for help?

And she didn't rush to fix it. 💛 His answers showed a pattern: lunch was the hard part. Then one night it came out: "I feel alone at lunch." 💔

"Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out." Proverbs 20:5

With a trusted adult at school and patient questions at home, two weeks later Caleb ran through the door smiling. ❤️ Patient questions are love in action.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto

❤️ Love in action
